annotations.title: List doctors and staff who take bookings

description: Use this when someone asks which doctors, nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice. Returns up to 100 staff display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or sick days.
name: list_providers

providers.description: Display names of staff with a doctor, nurse or assistant role. Staff identifiers, contact details, role records and clinical data are never returned.
